"""A tiny game to build on. Change the numbers and see what happens."""

import pygame

# Things you can change
WIDTH = 640
HEIGHT = 480
PLAYER_SPEED = 5
PLAYER_SIZE = 40
BACKGROUND = (18, 22, 34)
EAGLE_COLOUR = (255, 200, 100)
CAR_COLOUR = (100, 100, 100)
EAGLE_SIZE = 40
CAR_SIZE = 40
EAGLE_SPEED = 3
CAR_SPEED = 1
BACKGROUND = (240, 240, 240)
PLAYER_COLOUR = (214, 142, 62)

pygame.init()
screen = pygame.display.set_mode((WIDTH, HEIGHT))
pygame.display.set_caption("My Game")
clock = pygame.time.Clock()

player = pygame.Rect(WIDTH // 2, HEIGHT // 2, PLAYER_SIZE, PLAYER_SIZE)

running = True
while running:
    for event in pygame.event.get():
        if event.type == pygame.QUIT:
            running = False
        elif event.type == pygame.KEYDOWN and event.key == pygame.K_ESCAPE:
            running = False

    keys = pygame.key.get_pressed()
    if keys[pygame.K_LEFT]:
        player.x -= PLAYER_SPEED
    if keys[pygame.K_RIGHT]:
        player.x += PLAYER_SPEED
    if keys[pygame.K_UP]:
        player.y -= PLAYER_SPEED
    if keys[pygame.K_DOWN]:
        player.y += PLAYER_SPEED

    player.clamp_ip(screen.get_rect())

    # Create eagle and cars
    eagle = pygame.Rect(WIDTH // 2 - 100, 100, EAGLE_SIZE, EAGLE_SIZE)
    cars = [pygame.Rect(100 + i*100, 400, CAR_SIZE, CAR_SIZE) for i in range(5)]
    
    # Update eagle position
    eagle.x += EAGLE_SPEED
    if eagle.x > WIDTH - EAGLE_SIZE or eagle.x < 0:
        eagle.x = max(0, min(WIDTH - EAGLE_SIZE, eagle.x))
        EAGLE_SPEED *= -1
    
    # Update car positions
    for car in cars:
        car.x += CAR_SPEED
        if car.x > WIDTH or car.x < -CAR_SIZE:
            car.x = max(0, min(WIDTH, car.x))
            CAR_SPEED *= -1
    
    # Draw the eagle
    pygame.draw.rect(screen, EAGLE_COLOUR, eagle)
    
    # Draw the cars
    for car in cars:
        pygame.draw.rect(screen, CAR_COLOUR, car)
    
    pygame.display.flip()
    pygame.display.flip()
    clock.tick(60)

pygame.quit()
